title: barbaacha urjii ibsu mirkanaa’aa barbaaduu
intro: Samii halkanii balʼaa jala dhaabbattee, wanta dhuguma of kennuu malu barbaadaa utuu jirtuu, ibsaan ifaa kaʼee achiis akka badu ilaaluu. Naannoo keetti fakkiiwwan callisanii bocaman faaruu fi aarsaa ni argatu, taʼus sababni ifa taʼe humna isaanii gaaffii keessa galcha. Sagaleen sodaa hin qabne tokko duudhaa dhaalamee gara Uumaa samii fi lafaa akeekuuf jedha.
clues: Urjiilee, ji’aa fi aduu ilaaleen, waan lixaniif, waan badaniif Gooftaa koo ta’uu hin danda’an jedheen sababeeffadhe.
Waan sabni kiyya Rabbiin alatti gabbaran ifatti ganee Uumaa qofa akka gabbaraniif isaan waame.
Bulchaa of jajuu lubbuu fi du’a nan kenna jedhu tokko falmeen, Rabbiin baha irraa aduu fide kaasuun deebii kenne.
Waaqolii tolfamoo sana rukutee caccabse, ummanni akka itti deebi'uuf isaan keessaa isa guddaa qofa dhiise.
Caasaa ijaaraa ibidda boba’aa keessa na gatan jedhee ummata kootiin qabamee balaaleffame.
Rabbiin ibiddi akka naaf qabbanaa’uu fi nageenya naaf ta’u ajajeen fayye.

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
